name: cross-surface-cleanup-red-team-e2e-closure
objective: Perform final Captain-bounded cross-surface convergence, cleanup, adversarial review, physical/runtime evidence and exact-SHA closure without pulling unrelated product scope into the package.
truthOwner: Final closure is allowed only when all Captain-bounded owners and consumers agree on the exact final candidate and no known fixable Captain defect or cleanup residue remains.

tasks.objective: Perform Captain-only cleanup and cross-surface convergence
tasks.currentProblem: Individual fixes can leave dead/duplicate routes, stale copy/config or mismatched authorized readbacks.
tasks.requiredChange: Census all touched Captain/shared callers, delete proven dead/legacy residue, remove permission/config/dependency noise, verify partner/client/control-panel projections only for Captain-caused state and run full contract/boundary/database/runtime guards.
tasks.targetState: The repository has one clean Captain path per concern and every authorized consumer reads the same canonical result.
tasks.action: Run reachability/dependency census, delete proven residue, verify only Captain-linked cross-surfaces, then rerun all required guards after the final cleanup write.
mustNotChange: Do not expand into unrelated product journeys.
Do not leave dead/duplicate Captain paths.
Do not delete valid shared consumers without reachability proof.
Do not claim green from partial checks.
acceptanceCriteria: No known dead/duplicate/stale Captain residue remains.
Cross-surface readbacks agree with canonical owners.
Unrelated surface behavior is not modified.
All cleanup/boundary/contract checks pass after final write.
tasks.rollback: Revert only focused cleanup that broke a proven valid consumer; do not restore dead duplicate truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final cleanup/hardening commit before exact-SHA evidence.

tasks.objective: Run adversarial E2E and bind exact-SHA closure evidence
tasks.currentProblem: Partial green checks or stale evidence can hide cross-layer races and regressions.
tasks.requiredChange: After the last product write, run full Captain mobile, Identity/Workforce/DSH/WLT tests, DB/contracts, runtime smoke, native device flows, security/adversarial matrix and CI; re-resolve BB, record exact resulting SHA/check evidence, then run strict plus closure package validation only when every required unit is PASS.
tasks.targetState: Zero known fixable Captain defect remains and all closure evidence belongs to the same final candidate.
tasks.action: Execute the complete verification matrix, intentionally attack negative/race/offline/native/financial cases, record exact evidence, re-pin after bookkeeping and reject closure on any stale/failed/unproven requirement.
mustNotChange: No skipped required check without authority.
No unrelated defect repair to manufacture Captain green.
No closure with known fixable Captain issue.
acceptanceCriteria: All required unit checks are PASS on final SHA.
Physical/runtime E2E and adversarial matrix pass.
Branch has not moved to an unverified Captain-related head.
Strict closure validator exits zero only after evidence is recorded.
tasks.rollback: Any failure reopens affected units; preserve evidence and canonical history instead of masking the failure.
tasks.commitBoundary: Bookkeeping only after final product evidence, followed by repin and closure validation.
